_comment: Khatm series plan (built 2026-10-04). References and estimated durations only; no Quran text, translation or audio is stored. Text, translation and audio are fetched fresh from the Quran.com API at render time. Durations come from the API timing data of the assigned reciter and are estimates (the renderer trims silence at both ends).

rules.splitAt: waqf signs (plain word boundary only when no waqf fits)

under25Exceptions: 33:54-54 17.1s (between a split ayah / the surah edge and an ayah that would push it over 90 s)
103:1-3 21.1s (the whole surah is shorter than 25 s)
108:1-3 18.5s (the whole surah is shorter than 25 s)
112:1-4 19.9s (the whole surah is shorter than 25 s)
